note: Where each file in public/assets/games came from. Everything under `art` comes from a source we may republish: our sister site SlotEssentials, or the studio's own game page (scripts/fetch-studio-art.mjs, which records the page as `page`). Operator CDNs are never used. `heldPendingRights` lists titles whose only art sits on an operator's CDN and has not yet been replaced from the studio's own site.
